text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. It allows machines to recognise faces, read text, and identify objects in pictures. Object detection is an important part of this technology because it lets a computer find and locate things in an image. There are many useful applications in our daily lives, such as security cameras and medical imaging. One of the most exciting examples is self-driving cars, which use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and avoid accidents. Thanks to these advances, machines can now understand the world around them much better than before.
